name: Kibako
source:
Kibako is a mysterious girl that is often seen hanging out in the forest near Ifo, one of the cities in the Free Cities Alliance.

Who she is, or where she comes from is shrouded in mystery. She seems to have been involved in some accident or abandoned by her parents and she isn't clear about it, but what it is clear is that she's been living in the forests on her own since an early age.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Kibako]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
